amenitiesDescription:
Aria Reserve's more than 2 acres of amenities span three distinct levels: Bay Level, SkyLobby Level, and Garden Level.

The Bay Level puts residents directly at the water with a resort pool and waterfront promenade overlooking Biscayne Bay. The SkyLobby Level offers co-working suites, private meeting rooms, and social lounges for the live-work-play lifestyle. The Garden Level — an entire floor devoted to sport, wellness, and family — includes elite fitness facilities, sports courts, children's amenities, and panoramic water views.

24-hour concierge, security, and valet complete the offering.
architectQuote: Scale and intimacy rarely coexist. Aria Reserve resolves that tension by framing the bay so completely that every residence feels like a private waterfront estate.

description: The tallest waterfront twin towers in the United States. Two 62-story glass towers on over 5 acres of Biscayne Bay in Edgewater. South Tower is move-in ready with closings underway. North Tower move-in readiness is expected toward the end of 2026, with closings projected in the next 2–3 months.

signals.title: Melo Group — delivered every project on time
signals.body: Melo Group has developed over 30 buildings in Miami over 25 years with no failed deliveries. In a market with developer risk, execution history is a meaningful differentiator.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: Aria Reserve is the rare case where scale is the differentiator rather than scarcity. The full-service marina, 75,000+ sqft of amenities, and the bayfront footprint create a lifestyle category that boutique projects can't replicate. For buyers seeking a primary Edgewater home or a rental income vehicle, the entry point — below $1,300/sqft for direct Biscayne Bay — represents compelling value in a neighborhood where comparable resale now trades above that level.

investmentThesis: Over 5 acres of Biscayne Bay waterfront with 547 linear feet of water frontage, a land position that is effectively irreplaceable in the Edgewater corridor. More than 2 acres of exclusive amenities span three levels. Melo Group serves as developer and general contractor. South Tower is move-in ready with closings underway. North Tower move-in readiness is expected toward the end of 2026, with closings projected in the next 2–3 months. 95% sold across both towers, with remaining inventory concentrated in premium upper-floor and penthouse positions. Located minutes from Wynwood, the Design District, Brickell, and Miami Beach.
name: Aria Reserve
residenceContent: Two sinuous glass towers draw their form from the meeting of water and land, their mirrored curved facades designed by Arquitectonica principal Bernardo Fort-Brescia. Every residence features floor-to-ceiling impact glass, private elevator access, and expansive bayfront terraces. One- to four-bedroom layouts include Panoramic Residences (floors 3–56), Skyview Villas (47–56), Penthouse Residences (57–59), and Tri-Level Penthouse Mansions on the top three floors — with Italian porcelain flooring, Snaidero cabinetry, Bosch appliance packages, and smart home readiness throughout. Interiors by MORADA Haute Furniture Boutique; landscape architecture by ArquitectonicaGEO.
